summary: This directory centralizes the logic for determining file system locations for knowledge-based artifacts. It ensures consistent path resolution throughout the system by mapping configuration settings and context to specific storage directories.
responsibilities: Calculate base file system paths for knowledge assets
Resolve directory structures based on configuration inputs
Standardize location mapping for system artifacts
relationships: The system uses configuration settings to define the base paths where knowledge artifacts are stored.
Path resolution logic transforms context data into valid file system paths for consistent artifact management.
designDecisions: Centralization of path generation logic to avoid scattered file system dependencies
Configuration-driven path resolution to support environment-specific storage requirements
